description: Single numbers that shape how the mashup feels.

rows.meaning: Catherine's clock speed while a Team conversation is on screen (game input is blocked meanwhile).
rows._notes: 1.0 = don't touch the clock. If the tower keeps crumbling during the intro, lower it (0 can freeze games that pace frames with the same clock).

rows.meaning: How long a line said mid-climb (boss taunts, power calls) stays on screen; these never block input.
Portrait height as a fraction of the screen height.
Length of the Persona cut-in banner when a power is used.
